articles.title: Kerala BJP leader surrenders year after Rs 8-cr heist in Qatar, claims he was
articles.summary: A Kerala man accused of helping steal 3. 1 million Qatari riyals (nearly Rs 8 crore) from a welfare fund in Doha has surrendered to police, nearly a year after the robbery. articles.title: India smartphone market slumps 20% YoY, Samsung returns to No. 1 spot after nine
articles.summary: India's smartphone shipments fell 20% year-on-year (YoY) in the July-September quarter of 2026 to their lowest level in a decade, as rising memory prices pushed up phone costs and weakened demand. According to Counterpoint Research, Samsung reclaimed the top spot after nine quarters, with a 17% market share, as it performed better than the overall market.

articles.title: Tripura Mourns 17 Lives Lost to Accidents, Crime in Durga Puja 2026
articles.summary: At least 17 people died across the state in the thirteen days between Mahalaya on October 10 and the post-Dashami holiday on October 22, in a string of incidents ranging from a double homicide in Dharmanagar and an alleged domestic murder in Boxanagar to fatal road crashes and a fairground ride malfunction on Vijaya Dashami morning.

articles.title: ITBP chief says China face-offs ongoing along Arunachal, Congress attacks PM
articles.summary: It marks the first official confirmation of ongoing face-offs on the north-eastern border in Arunachal, where the situation has grown increasingly tense in recent months. ITBP Director General Shatrujeet Kapur said the face-offs have been ongoing since July, when reports emerged that Chinese troops were denying Indian forces access to key patrolling points along the LAC in the Taksing area.

articles.title: Face-offs with China continuing along Arunachal border, says ITBP chief
articles.summary: The ITBP chief, however, said the force's Shaurya commandos performed "exceptionally well" during the confrontations. "Our newly raised Shaurya commandos played an exemplary role in this," he said. The Shaurya commandos specialise in high-altitude warfare. The ITBP, raised in 1962, guards the 3,488-km-long Line of Actual Control (LAC) with China.

articles.summary: Representatives from 196 countries are meeting in Yerevan to evaluate biodiversity progress under the 2030 targets. The Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework aims to restore ecosystems and phase out harmful subsidies. articles.title_hi: पत्नी पति की सहमति के बिना उसे नशा मुक्ति केंद्र में रखने की अनुमति नहीं दे सकती
articles.summary_hi: 4). केंद्र ने कथित तौर पर कॉर्पस की पत्नी (प्रतिवादी संख्या 5) के आदेश पर कॉर्पस को सीमित कर दिया।   तथ्यों के अनुसार, कॉर्पस और उसकी पत्नी के बीच गहरे तनावपूर्ण संबंध थे और वे अलग-अलग रह रहे थे। कॉर्पस ने पहले अपनी पत्नी और उसके परिवार के सदस्यों के खिलाफ शारीरिक हमले और उत्पीड़न के लिए कई पुलिस शिकायतें दर्ज की थीं।

articles.summary_hinglish: 4). kendra ne kathita taura para korpasa ki patni (prativadi sankhya 5) ke aadesha para korpasa ko simita kara diya। tathyon ke anusar, korpasa aura usaki patni ke bicha gahare tanavapurna sanbandha the aura ve alaga-alaga raha rahe the। korpasa ne pahale apani patni aura usake parivara ke sadasyon ke khilapha sharirika hamale aura utpidana ke lie kaee pulisa shikayaten darja ki thin।
